easyPrerequisites: Werefox Bodyguard must be exiled by Lagrella, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Lagrella until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Werefox Bodyguard is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Werefox Bodyguard's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Werefox Bodyguard until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
